verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms NVIDIA ships a general CUDA Toolkit and Tensor Core architecture details relevant to deep learning, but there is no explicit official PyTorch/TensorFlow support matrix, compute-capability listing, or documented install path referencing RTX 5090/Blackwell specifically; a community post even flags 5090 as impractical for local LLM work due to price, not toolchain issues. missing for 10: explicit PyTorch build/support-matrix docs naming RTX 5090 or Blackwell (sm_120) compute capability, cuDNN/cuBLAS version compatibility notes, and independent confirmation of PyTorch working out-of-the-box on the card.
